objections.claim: E6's pure-ABI repair is bypassed by its own invocation contract. It requires `file` entries to run directly under `node` and `npm-script` entries directly through `npm run`, while its determinism proof depends on every oracle executing only as a pure function inside an evaluator exposing no filesystem, environment, clock, or entropy. The stated static import/entrypoint conformance check does not constrain package.json shell command chains, Node globals, or wrappers that return an exit code without invoking the evaluator. Such an oracle can still observe clock/entropy and is governed only by the acknowledged heuristic repeated-evaluation fallback, so the deterministic guarantee does not cover all mandatory oracle kinds. Require every file/npm-script declaration to be an evaluator-bound adapter with arbitrary host execution rejected, and add escape regressions for package-script chaining, ambient Node globals, and evaluator-skipping wrappers.
